title_he: הוֹי אֲשֶׁר הָפַכְתָּ אֶת־הַמְּרוֹרוֹת שֶׁבְּחַיַּי לְרַנֵּן

verses_he.label: القرار
lines: זוֹכֵר אֲנִי לְךָ, זוֹכֵר אֲנִי לְךָ

review: The hymn is the retrospect of grace: 1:1–8 is Ps 30:12 (הָפַכְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי לְמָחוֹל) with Ps 32:1 and Ps 139:18, the chorus is Ps 103:2, 2:1–8 is Ps 65:12 with Song 3:11 and Phil 3:8, and 3:1–8 is Ps 73:23 with Matt 26:70–75 and Phil 1:6.

The chorus is two lines and stands after stanza 1 (8/2/8/8), as the print's short [القرار]; the payload keeps the doubled 'I remember' followed by the single summary line, because the repetition is the hymn's whole gesture.

1:1 הָפַכְתָּ … לְשִׁירֵי רִנָּה is the psalm's exchange of mourning for dancing (Ps 30:12) with the added plural 'songs', which follows the print's لترنيمات and lets the stanza count blessings rather than announce one.
